summary: Application security engineer breaking enterprise web architectures and engineering resilient backends. I pair offensive exploitation with code-level remediation, alongside research into verifiable malware data integrity.
researchIntro: Engineering verifiable data architectures, cryptographic integrity proofs, and intelligent security systems designed to withstand adversarial tampering.

research.title: Blockchain and LLM Integration for Data Integrity Verification in Malware Analysis
research.description: Designing a verification mechanism that records malware analysis results on-chain through Solidity smart contracts, making data immutable after submission. A Large Language Model is integrated into the analysis workflow to interpret and summarize findings, reducing manual triage time for security analysts.

research.title: Rancang Bangun Sistem Antarmuka ParQR Untuk Pemantauan Dan Pelanggaran Parkir Liar Secara Real-Time
research.description: A real-time monitoring and violation detection interface integrating machine learning with automated telemetry to identify unauthorized parking. The system tracks occupancy states, detects infractions in real time, and dispatches automated enforcement logs.

experience.title: Security Engineer
items: Perform penetration tests on enterprise web applications and APIs against the OWASP Top 10, using Burp Suite Professional, Nmap, FFUF, SQLMap and Nuclei.
Identify and manually validate vulnerabilities such as broken access control, injection and authentication flaws, removing false positives before findings reach developers.
Report findings to engineering teams with reproduction steps, business impact and remediation guidance, then retest fixes to confirm each issue is closed.
Work with engineering leads to improve the remediation process, from severity-based prioritization to fix verification.

Turn product requirements into backend milestones with the product team; the project received P2MW funding and was selected for KMIEXPO 2026.
